ccd.configuration.boosterPump.stressMult: Stress cost relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.pressureMu: Pumping pressure relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed; affects flow rate. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.rangeMulti: Multiplier of the configured Mechanical Pump range, applied to each side. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.fluidArm.allowDirectCo: When disabled, arms require Fluid Hatches. When enabled, they can target accessible container faces directly. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.smartTank.maxFluidType: Maximum fluid types per vertical or horizontal tank structure. Different components count separately; lowering the limit preserves existing contents. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.waterSupply.rate.toolt: Measured in mB/tick per container, supplied in batches. -1 fills available space per operation; 0 disables automatic supply. Manual extraction is unaffected. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.normalConsump: Measured in mB/second of active spray. Custom atomizing recipes may override this value. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.potionConsump: Measured in mB/second of potion spray. Custom recipes may override this value. Reopen the world to apply changes.

ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_1: Attach fluid packagers to the fluid container they should target
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_2: Given redstone power, it will pack fluids from the container into a package
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_3: These can be picked up and transported like any other item
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_4: Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the fluids into the container
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_5: R-Click with a filled container to filter Redstone-triggered packaging
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_6: A Fluid Repackager combines items and fluids from the same order into Brass Packages
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_1: Fluid Hatches provide access to fluids in the container behind them
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_2: R-Click the front with a fluid container to empty or fill it
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_3: Smart Fluid Hatches can restrict which fluids may pass
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_4: Mechanical Fluid Arms have to be assigned their in- and outputs before they are placed
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_5: Supply rotational power to move fluids between the selected locations
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_1: All faces of a Fluid Access Port share access to its attached container
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_2: Fluid Access Ports and Fluid Bridges cannot extend each other
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_3: A Fluid Bridge provides access to both end containers through one interface
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_4: Use filters to assign different fluids to each container
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.header: Dimensions of a Smart Fluid Tank
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_1: Smart Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_2: Their cross-section can be 1×1, 2×2 or 3×3 blocks
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_3: Horizontal Smart Fluid Tanks can be extended horizontally
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_4: A single tank structure can store multiple fluids
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_5: Using a Wrench, a tanks' window can be toggled
ccd.ponder.fluid_faucets.text_1: Faucets attach to the side of a fluid container
ccd.ponder.fluid_faucets.text_2: Open the Faucet to fill a container directly below
ccd.ponder.fluid_faucets.text_3: Smart Faucets can also fill items on Belts or Depots two blocks below
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_1: Supply rotation at the rear and connect Fluid Pipes at the sides
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_2: Handheld fluid containers can also be emptied or filled by R-Clicking
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_3: Air currents passing through the Atomizer can process items in bulk
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_4: A Redstone Signal stops atomizing without stopping the air current
ccd.ponder.fluid_switching.text_1: The silver connector is shared by both connections

ccd.ponder.fluid_switching.text_3: A Redstone Signal switches it to the side connection
ccd.ponder.fluid_switching.text_4: Mechanical Pumps still determine the direction of flow
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_1: Collection Grates collect fluids touching their top face
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_2: Collected fluids drain into a container directly below
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_3: Smart Collection Grates can filter fluids; Redstone pauses collection and draining
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_4: Water Supply Boxes automatically supply water to adjacent containers on all six sides
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_5: Copper Water Basins supply handheld containers and pipes, but do not fill adjacent containers automatically
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_1: Fluid Transmitters move fluids between end containers without rotational power
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_2: The arrow indicates the direction of flow
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_3: A Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_4: A Redstone Signal pauses the transfer
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_1: Booster Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_2: Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_3: A Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_4: Greater pumping pressure and range come with a higher Stress Impact
